supersededSourceRecords.reason: Current reviewed Wahapedia HTML replaces the accepted May 2026 bulk warscroll and faction-rule records. Superseded rows remain dispositioned for audit but cannot enter the current runtime. Extended 2026-09-22 (issue #1999): the September 2026 Sons of Behemat battletome rewrites six legacy datasheets (King Brodd, Beast-smasher Mega-Gargant, Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant, Kraken-eater Mega-Gargant, Warstomper Mega-Gargant, Mancrusher Gargant); their prior Wahapedia rows (warscroll, abilities, weapons, keywords, bases) move to superseded, adding 92 rows, each rewrite adopting its replaced datasheet’s canonical identity.
